Follow `AGENTS.md` at the repo root (including "Coaching the designer"), and read `specs/TECH_SPEC.md` before editing code.
`specs/GAME_DESIGN.md` is owned by the human designer: in build mode never edit it; put suggestions in `specs/proposals/`.
Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS only, no build step. Do not invent game design; log gaps in `specs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md`.
If the user asks for something not in the design doc, is vague, or skips a task file, offer the quick spec step first (one sentence, one offer). Always end a task by saying which spec lines changed, or "No spec changes needed".
